versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֕י מִקֵּ֖ץ שְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֑ים וּפַרְעֹ֣ה חֹלֵ֔ם וְהִנֵּ֖ה עֹמֵ֥ד עַל־הַיְאֹֽר׃

controles.web: At the end of two full years, Pharaoh dreamed: and behold, he stood by the river.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que passados dois anos teve Faraó um sonho: Parecia-lhe que estava junto ao rio;

versos.hebraico: וְהִנֵּ֣ה מִן־הַיְאֹ֗ר עֹלֹת֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פָּר֔וֹת יְפ֥וֹת מַרְאֶ֖ה וּבְרִיאֹ֣ת בָּשָׂ֑ר וַתִּרְעֶ֖ינָה בָּאָֽחוּ׃

controles.web: Behold, there came up out of the river seven cattle, sleek and fat, and they fed in the marsh grass.
controles.kjv: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.
controles.livre: E que do rio subiam sete vacas, belas à vista, e muito gordas, e pastavam entre os juncos:

versos.hebraico: וְהִנֵּ֞ה שֶׁ֧בַע פָּר֣וֹת אֲחֵר֗וֹת עֹל֤וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן֙ מִן־הַיְאֹ֔ר רָע֥וֹת מַרְאֶ֖ה וְדַקּ֣וֹת בָּשָׂ֑ר וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֛דְנָה אֵ֥צֶל הַפָּר֖וֹת עַל־שְׂפַ֥ת הַיְאֹֽר׃

controles.web: Behold, seven other cattle came up after them out of the river, ugly and thin, and stood by the other cattle on the brink of the river.
controles.kjv: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.
controles.livre: E que outras sete vacas subiam depois delas do rio, de feia aparência, e magras de carne, e pararam perto das vacas belas à beira do rio;

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּאכַ֣לְנָה הַפָּר֗וֹת רָע֤וֹת הַמַּרְאֶה֙ וְדַקֹּ֣ת הַבָּשָׂ֔ר אֵ֚ת שֶׁ֣בַע הַפָּר֔וֹת יְפֹ֥ת הַמַּרְאֶ֖ה וְהַבְּרִיאֹ֑ת וַיִּיקַ֖ץ פַּרְעֹֽה׃

controles.web: The ugly and thin cattle ate up the seven sleek and fat cattle. So Pharaoh awoke.
controles.kjv: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.
controles.livre: E que as vacas de feia aparência e magras de carne devoravam as sete vacas belas e muito gordas. E despertou Faraó.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּישָׁ֕ן וַֽיַּחֲלֹ֖ם שֵׁנִ֑ית וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֗ים עֹל֛וֹת בְּקָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד בְּרִיא֥וֹת וְטֹבֽוֹת׃

controles.web: He slept and dreamed a second time: and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, healthy and good.
controles.kjv: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
controles.livre: Dormiu de novo, e sonhou a segunda vez: Que sete espigas cheias e belas subiam de uma só haste:

versos.hebraico: וְהִנֵּה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֔ים דַּקּ֖וֹת וּשְׁדוּפֹ֣ת קָדִ֑ים צֹמְח֖וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶֽן׃

controles.web: Behold, seven heads of grain, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.
controles.kjv: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.
controles.livre: E que outras sete espigas miúdas e abatidas do vento oriental, saíam depois delas:

versos.hebraico: וַתִּבְלַ֨עְנָה֙ הַשִּׁבֳּלִ֣ים הַדַּקּ֔וֹת אֵ֚ת שֶׁ֣בַע הַֽשִּׁבֳּלִ֔ים הַבְּרִיא֖וֹת וְהַמְּלֵא֑וֹת וַיִּיקַ֥ץ פַּרְעֹ֖ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה חֲלֽוֹם׃

controles.web: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.
controles.kjv: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.
controles.livre: E as sete espigas miúdas devoravam as sete espigas espessas e cheias. E despertou Faraó, e eis que era sonho.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֤י בַבֹּ֨קֶר֙ וַתִּפָּ֣עֶם רוּח֔וֹ וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח וַיִּקְרָ֛א אֶת־כָּל־חַרְטֻמֵּ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם וְאֶת־כָּל־חֲכָמֶ֑יהָ וַיְסַפֵּ֨ר פַּרְעֹ֤ה לָהֶם֙ אֶת־חֲלֹמ֔וֹ וְאֵין־פּוֹתֵ֥ר אוֹתָ֖ם לְפַרְעֹֽה׃

controles.web: In the morning, his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all of Egypt’s magicians and wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que à manhã estava movido seu espírito; e enviou e fez chamar a todos os magos do Egito, e a todos os seus sábios: e contou-lhes Faraó seus sonhos, mas não havia quem a Faraó os interpretasse.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּר֙ שַׂ֣ר הַמַּשְׁקִ֔ים אֶת־פַּרְעֹ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אֶת־חֲטָאַ֕י אֲנִ֖י מַזְכִּ֥יר הַיּֽוֹם׃

controles.web: Then the chief cup bearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, “I remember my faults today.
controles.kjv: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:
controles.livre: Então o chefe dos copeiros falou a Faraó, dizendo: Lembro-me hoje de minhas faltas:

versos.hebraico: פַּרְעֹ֖ה קָצַ֣ף עַל־עֲבָדָ֑יו וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אֹתִ֜י בְּמִשְׁמַ֗ר בֵּ֚ית שַׂ֣ר הַטַּבָּחִ֔ים אֹתִ֕י וְאֵ֖ת שַׂ֥ר הָאֹפִֽים׃

controles.web: Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, me and the chief baker.
controles.kjv: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard’s house, both me and the chief baker:
controles.livre: Faraó se irou contra seus servos, e a mim me lançou à prisão da casa do capitão dos da guarda, a mim e ao chefe dos padeiros:

versos.hebraico: וַנַּֽחַלְמָ֥ה חֲל֛וֹם בְּלַ֥יְלָה אֶחָ֖ד אֲנִ֣י וָה֑וּא אִ֛ישׁ כְּפִתְר֥וֹן חֲלֹמ֖וֹ חָלָֽמְנוּ׃

controles.web: We dreamed a dream in one night, I and he. We dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
controles.kjv: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
controles.livre: E eu e ele vimos um sonho uma mesma noite: cada um sonhou conforme a interpretação de seu sonho.

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁ֨ם אִתָּ֜נוּ נַ֣עַר עִבְרִ֗י עֶ֚בֶד לְשַׂ֣ר הַטַּבָּחִ֔ים וַנְּ֨סַפֶּר־ל֔וֹ וַיִּפְתָּר־לָ֖נוּ אֶת־חֲלֹמֹתֵ֑ינוּ אִ֥ישׁ כַּחֲלֹמ֖וֹ פָּתָֽר׃

controles.web: There was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard, and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams. To each man according to his dream he interpreted.
controles.kjv: And there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.
controles.livre: E estava ali conosco um jovem hebreu, servente do capitão dos da guarda; e o contamos a ele, e ele nos interpretou nossos sonhos, e interpretou a cada um conforme seu sonho.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֛י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּֽתַר־לָ֖נוּ כֵּ֣ן הָיָ֑ה אֹתִ֛י הֵשִׁ֥יב עַל־כַּנִּ֖י וְאֹת֥וֹ תָלָֽה׃

controles.web: As he interpreted to us, so it was. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him.”
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que como ele nos interpretou, assim foi: a mim me fez voltar a meu posto, e fez enforcar ao outro.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח פַּרְעֹה֙ וַיִּקְרָ֣א אֶת־יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיְרִיצֻ֖הוּ מִן־הַבּ֑וֹר וַיְגַלַּח֙ וַיְחַלֵּ֣ף שִׂמְלֹתָ֔יו וַיָּבֹ֖א אֶל־פַּרְעֹֽה׃

controles.web: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. He shaved himself, changed his clothing, and came in to Pharaoh.
controles.kjv: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.
controles.livre: Então Faraó enviou e chamou a José; e fizeram-lhe sair correndo do cárcere; e ele rapou-se a barba, mudou-se de roupas, e veio a Faraó.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶל־יוֹסֵ֔ף חֲל֣וֹם חָלַ֔מְתִּי וּפֹתֵ֖ר אֵ֣ין אֹת֑וֹ וַאֲנִ֗י שָׁמַ֤עְתִּי עָלֶ֨יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר תִּשְׁמַ֥ע חֲל֖וֹם לִפְתֹּ֥ר אֹתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it. I have heard it said of you, that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.”
controles.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.
controles.livre: E disse Faraó a José: Eu tive um sonho, e não há quem o interprete; mas ouvi dizer de ti, que ouves sonhos para os interpretar.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֨עַן יוֹסֵ֧ף אֶת־פַּרְעֹ֛ה לֵאמֹ֖ר בִּלְעָדָ֑י אֱלֹהִ֕ים יַעֲנֶ֖ה אֶת־שְׁל֥וֹם פַּרְעֹֽה׃

controles.web: Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “It isn’t in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”
controles.kjv: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.
controles.livre: E respondeu José a Faraó, dizendo: Não está em mim; Deus será o que responda paz a Faraó.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶל־יוֹסֵ֑ף בַּחֲלֹמִ֕י הִנְנִ֥י עֹמֵ֖ד עַל־שְׂפַ֥ת הַיְאֹֽר׃

controles.web: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, behold, I stood on the brink of the river:
controles.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:
controles.livre: Então Faraó disse a José: Em meu sonho parecia-me que estava à beira do rio:

versos.hebraico: וְהִנֵּ֣ה מִן־הַיְאֹ֗ר עֹלֹת֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פָּר֔וֹת בְּרִיא֥וֹת בָּשָׂ֖ר וִיפֹ֣ת תֹּ֑אַר וַתִּרְעֶ֖ינָה בָּאָֽחוּ׃

controles.web: and behold, there came up out of the river seven cattle, fat and sleek. They fed in the marsh grass,
controles.kjv: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:
controles.livre: E que do rio subiam sete vacas de gordas carnes e bela aparência, que pastavam entre os juncos:

versos.hebraico: וְהִנֵּ֞ה שֶֽׁבַע־פָּר֤וֹת אֲחֵרוֹת֙ עֹל֣וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ן דַּלּ֨וֹת וְרָע֥וֹת תֹּ֛אַר מְאֹ֖ד וְרַקּ֣וֹת בָּשָׂ֑ר לֹֽא־רָאִ֧יתִי כָהֵ֛נָּה בְּכָל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לָרֹֽעַ׃

controles.web: and behold, seven other cattle came up after them, poor and very ugly and thin, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for ugliness.
controles.kjv: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:
controles.livre: E que outras sete vacas subiam depois delas, magras e de muito feio aspecto; tão abatidas, que não vi outras semelhantes em toda a terra do Egito em feiura:

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּאכַ֨לְנָה֙ הַפָּר֔וֹת הָרַקּ֖וֹת וְהָרָע֑וֹת אֵ֣ת שֶׁ֧בַע הַפָּר֛וֹת הָרִאשֹׁנ֖וֹת הַבְּרִיאֹֽת׃

controles.web: The thin and ugly cattle ate up the first seven fat cattle,
controles.kjv: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
controles.livre: E as vacas magras e feias devoravam as sete primeiras vacas gordas:

versos.hebraico: וַתָּבֹ֣אנָה אֶל־קִרְבֶּ֗נָה וְלֹ֤א נוֹדַע֙ כִּי־בָ֣אוּ אֶל־קִרְבֶּ֔נָה וּמַרְאֵיהֶ֣ן רַ֔ע כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּתְּחִלָּ֑ה וָאִיקָֽץ׃

controles.web: and when they had eaten them up, it couldn’t be known that they had eaten them, but they were still ugly, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
controles.kjv: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
controles.livre: E entravam em suas entranhas, mas não se conhecia que houvesse entrado nelas, porque sua aparência era ainda má, como de antes. E eu despertei.

versos.hebraico: וָאֵ֖רֶא בַּחֲלֹמִ֑י וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֗ים עֹלֹ֛ת בְּקָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד מְלֵאֹ֥ת וְטֹבֽוֹת׃

controles.web: I saw in my dream, and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, full and good:
controles.kjv: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:
controles.livre: Vi também sonhando, que sete espigas subiam em uma mesma haste, cheias e belas;

versos.hebraico: וְהִנֵּה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֔ים צְנֻמ֥וֹת דַּקּ֖וֹת שְׁדֻפ֣וֹת קָדִ֑ים צֹמְח֖וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: and behold, seven heads of grain, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.
controles.kjv: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
controles.livre: E que outras sete espigas miúdas, definhadas, abatidas do vento oriental, subiam depois delas:

versos.hebraico: וַתִּבְלַ֨עְןָ֙ הָשִׁבֳּלִ֣ים הַדַּקֹּ֔ת אֵ֛ת שֶׁ֥בַע הַֽשִׁבֳּלִ֖ים הַטֹּב֑וֹת וָֽאֹמַר֙ אֶל־הַֽחַרְטֻמִּ֔ים וְאֵ֥ין מַגִּ֖יד לִֽי׃

controles.web: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads of grain. I told it to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me.”
controles.kjv: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.
controles.livre: E as espigas miúdas devoravam as sete espigas belas: e disse-o aos magos, mas não há quem o interprete a mim.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יוֹסֵף֙ אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֔ה חֲל֥וֹם פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶחָ֣ד ה֑וּא אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים עֹשֶׂ֖ה הִגִּ֥יד לְפַרְעֹֽה׃

controles.web: Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dream of Pharaoh is one. What God is about to do he has declared to Pharaoh.
controles.kjv: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.
controles.livre: Então respondeu José a Faraó: O sonho de Faraó é um mesmo: Deus mostrou a Faraó o que vai fazer.

versos.hebraico: שֶׁ֧בַע פָּרֹ֣ת הַטֹּבֹ֗ת שֶׁ֤בַע שָׁנִים֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְשֶׁ֤בַע הַֽשִּׁבֳּלִים֙ הַטֹּבֹ֔ת שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים הֵ֑נָּה חֲל֖וֹם אֶחָ֥ד הֽוּא׃

controles.web: The seven good cattle are seven years; and the seven good heads of grain are seven years. The dream is one.
controles.kjv: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.
controles.livre: As sete vacas belas são sete anos, e as espigas belas são sete anos; o sonho é um mesmo.

versos.hebraico: וְשֶׁ֣בַע הַ֠פָּרוֹת הָֽרַקּ֨וֹת וְהָרָעֹ֜ת הָעֹלֹ֣ת אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ן שֶׁ֤בַע שָׁנִים֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְשֶׁ֤בַע הַֽשִׁבֳּלִים֙ הָרֵק֔וֹת שְׁדֻפ֖וֹת הַקָּדִ֑ים יִהְי֕וּ שֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֥י רָעָֽב׃

controles.web: The seven thin and ugly cattle that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty heads of grain blasted with the east wind; they will be seven years of famine.
controles.kjv: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.
controles.livre: Também as sete vacas magras e feias que subiam atrás elas, são sete anos; e as sete espigas miúdas e definhadas do vento oriental serão sete anos de fome.

versos.hebraico: ה֣וּא הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים עֹשֶׂ֖ה הֶרְאָ֥ה אֶת־פַּרְעֹֽה׃

controles.web: That is the thing which I spoke to Pharaoh. What God is about to do he has shown to Pharaoh.
controles.kjv: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.
controles.livre: Isto é o que respondo a Faraó. O que Deus vai fazer, mostrou-o a Faraó.

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּ֛ה שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים בָּא֑וֹת שָׂבָ֥ע גָּד֖וֹל בְּכָל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt.
controles.kjv: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:
controles.livre: Eis que vêm sete anos de grande fartura toda a terra do Egito:

versos.hebraico: וְ֠קָמוּ שֶׁ֜בַע שְׁנֵ֤י רָעָב֙ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ן וְנִשְׁכַּ֥ח כָּל־הַשָּׂבָ֖ע בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְכִלָּ֥ה הָרָעָ֖ב אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: There will arise after them seven years of famine, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will consume the land,
controles.kjv: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;
controles.livre: E se levantarão depois eles sete anos de fome; e toda a fartura será esquecida na terra do Egito; e a fome consumirá a terra;

versos.hebraico: וְלֹֽא־יִוָּדַ֤ע הַשָּׂבָע֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ מִפְּנֵ֛י הָרָעָ֥ב הַה֖וּא אַחֲרֵי־כֵ֑ן כִּֽי־כָבֵ֥ד ה֖וּא מְאֹֽד׃

controles.web: and the plenty will not be known in the land by reason of that famine which follows; for it will be very grievous.
controles.kjv: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.
controles.livre: E aquela abundância não mais será vista por causa da fome seguinte, a qual será gravíssima.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֨ל הִשָּׁנ֧וֹת הַחֲל֛וֹם אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֖ה פַּעֲמָ֑יִם כִּֽי־נָכ֤וֹן הַדָּבָר֙ מֵעִ֣ם הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּמְמַהֵ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים לַעֲשֹׂתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh, because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
controles.kjv: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
controles.livre: E o suceder o sonho a Faraó duas vezes, significa que a coisa é firme da parte de Deus, e que Deus se apressa a fazê-la.

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּה֙ יֵרֶ֣א פַרְעֹ֔ה אִ֖ישׁ נָב֣וֹן וְחָכָ֑ם וִישִׁיתֵ֖הוּ עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: “Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a discreet and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.
controles.kjv: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
controles.livre: Portanto, providencie Faraó agora um homem prudente e sábio, e ponha-o sobre a terra do Egito.

versos.hebraico: יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה פַרְעֹ֔ה וְיַפְקֵ֥ד פְּקִדִ֖ים עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְחִמֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּשֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֥י הַשָּׂבָֽע׃

controles.web: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt’s produce in the seven plenteous years.
controles.kjv: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.
controles.livre: Faça isto Faraó, e ponha governadores sobre o país, e tome a quinta parte da terra do Egito nos sete anos da fartura;

versos.hebraico: וְיִקְבְּצ֗וּ אֶת־כָּל־אֹ֨כֶל֙ הַשָּׁנִ֣ים הַטֹּבֹ֔ת הַבָּאֹ֖ת הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְיִצְבְּרוּ־בָ֞ר תַּ֧חַת יַד־פַּרְעֹ֛ה אֹ֥כֶל בֶּעָרִ֖ים וְשָׁמָֽרוּ׃

controles.web: Let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and lay up grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.
controles.kjv: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.
controles.livre: E juntem toda a provisão destes bons anos que vêm, e acumulem o trigo sob a mão de Faraó para mantimento das cidades; e guardem-no.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֨ה הָאֹ֤כֶל לְפִקָּדוֹן֙ לָאָ֔רֶץ לְשֶׁ֨בַע֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הָרָעָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖יןָ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְלֹֽא־תִכָּרֵ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ בָּרָעָֽב׃

controles.web: The food will be for a store to the land against the seven years of famine, which will be in the land of Egypt; that the land not perish through the famine.”
controles.kjv: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
controles.livre: E esteja aquela provisão em depósito para o país, para os sete anos de fome que serão na terra do Egito; e o país não perecerá de fome.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּיטַ֥ב הַדָּבָ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וּבְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־עֲבָדָֽיו׃

controles.web: The thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
controles.kjv: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
controles.livre: E o negócio pareceu bem a Faraó, e a seus servos.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶל־עֲבָדָ֑יו הֲנִמְצָ֣א כָזֶ֔ה אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֛ר ר֥וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Pharaoh said to his servants, “Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?”
controles.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?
controles.livre: E disse Faraó a seus servos: Acharemos outro homem como este, em quem haja espírito de Deus?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶל־יוֹסֵ֔ף אַחֲרֵ֨י הוֹדִ֧יעַ אֱלֹהִ֛ים אוֹתְךָ֖ אֶת־כָּל־זֹ֑את אֵין־נָב֥וֹן וְחָכָ֖ם כָּמֽוֹךָ׃

controles.web: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Because God has shown you all of this, there is no one so discreet and wise as you.
controles.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:
controles.livre: E disse Faraó a José: Pois que Deus te fez saber tudo isto, não há entendido nem sábio como tu:

versos.hebraico: אַתָּה֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה עַל־בֵּיתִ֔י וְעַל־פִּ֖יךָ יִשַּׁ֣ק כָּל־עַמִּ֑י רַ֥ק הַכִּסֵּ֖א אֶגְדַּ֥ל מִמֶּֽךָּ׃

controles.web: You shall be over my house, and according to your word will all my people be ruled. Only in the throne I will be greater than you.”
controles.kjv: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.
controles.livre: Tu serás sobre minha casa, e pelo que disseres se governará todo o meu povo; somente no trono serei eu maior que tu.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶל־יוֹסֵ֑ף רְאֵה֙ נָתַ֣תִּי אֹֽתְךָ֔ עַ֖ל כָּל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Behold, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.”
controles.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.
controles.livre: Disse mais Faraó a José: Eis que te pus sobre toda a terra do Egito.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֨סַר פַּרְעֹ֤ה אֶת־טַבַּעְתּוֹ֙ מֵעַ֣ל יָד֔וֹ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֖הּ עַל־יַ֣ד יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיַּלְבֵּ֤שׁ אֹתוֹ֙ בִּגְדֵי־שֵׁ֔שׁ וַיָּ֛שֶׂם רְבִ֥ד הַזָּהָ֖ב עַל־צַוָּארֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it on Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in robes of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck,
controles.kjv: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
controles.livre: Então Faraó tirou seu anel de sua mão, e o pôs na mão de José, e fez-lhe vestir de roupas de linho finíssimo, e pôs um colar de ouro em seu pescoço;

versos.hebraico: וַיַּרְכֵּ֣ב אֹת֗וֹ בְּמִרְכֶּ֤בֶת הַמִּשְׁנֶה֙ אֲשֶׁר־ל֔וֹ וַיִּקְרְא֥וּ לְפָנָ֖יו אַבְרֵ֑ךְ וְנָת֣וֹן אֹת֔וֹ עַ֖ל כָּל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: and he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had. They cried before him, “Bow the knee!” He set him over all the land of Egypt.
controles.kjv: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.
controles.livre: E o fez subir em seu segundo carro, e proclamaram diante dele: Dobrai os joelhos; e pôs-lhe sobre toda a terra do Egito.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֛ה אֶל־יוֹסֵ֖ף אֲנִ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וּבִלְעָדֶ֗יךָ לֹֽא־יָרִ֨ים אִ֧ישׁ אֶת־יָד֛וֹ וְאֶת־רַגְל֖וֹ בְּכָל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh, and without you shall no man lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.”
controles.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.
controles.livre: E disse Faraó a José: Eu sou Faraó; e sem ti ninguém levantará sua mão nem seu pé toda a terra do Egito.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֨א פַרְעֹ֣ה שֵׁם־יוֹסֵף֮ צָֽפְנַ֣ת פַּעְנֵחַ֒ וַיִּתֶּן־ל֣וֹ אֶת־אָֽסְנַ֗ת בַּת־פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֛רַע כֹּהֵ֥ן אֹ֖ן לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַיֵּצֵ֥א יוֹסֵ֖ף עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-Paneah; and he gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.
controles.kjv: And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphnath–paaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti–pherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.
controles.livre: E chamou Faraó o nome de José, Zefenate-Paneia; e deu-lhe por mulher a Azenate, filha de Potífera, sacerdote de Om. E saiu José por toda a terra do Egito.

versos.hebraico: וְיוֹסֵף֙ בֶּן־שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּעָמְד֕וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־מִצְרָ֑יִם וַיֵּצֵ֤א יוֹסֵף֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וַֽיַּעְבֹ֖ר בְּכָל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
controles.kjv: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
controles.livre: E era José de idade de trinta anos quando foi apresentado diante de Faraó, rei do Egito: e saiu José de diante de Faraó, e transitou por toda a terra do Egito.

versos.hebraico: וַתַּ֣עַשׂ הָאָ֔רֶץ בְּשֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֣י הַשָּׂבָ֑ע לִקְמָצִֽים׃

controles.web: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.
controles.kjv: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
controles.livre: E fez a terra naqueles sete anos de fartura a amontoados.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְבֹּ֞ץ אֶת־כָּל־אֹ֣כֶל׀ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָיוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּתֶּן־אֹ֖כֶל בֶּעָרִ֑ים אֹ֧כֶל שְׂדֵה־הָעִ֛יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְבִיבֹתֶ֖יהָ נָתַ֥ן בְּתוֹכָֽהּ׃

controles.web: He gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was around every city, he laid up in the same.
controles.kjv: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.
controles.livre: E ele juntou todo o mantimento dos sete anos que foram na terra do Egito, e guardou mantimento nas cidades, pondo em cada cidade o mantimento do campo de seus arredores.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּצְבֹּ֨ר יוֹסֵ֥ף בָּ֛ר כְּח֥וֹל הַיָּ֖ם הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד עַ֛ד כִּי־חָדַ֥ל לִסְפֹּ֖ר כִּי־אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃

controles.web: Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, for it was without number.
controles.kjv: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.
controles.livre: E ajuntou José trigo como areia do mar, muito em extremo, até não se poder contar, porque não tinha número.

versos.hebraico: וּלְיוֹסֵ֤ף יֻלַּד֙ שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים בְּטֶ֥רֶם תָּב֖וֹא שְׁנַ֣ת הָרָעָ֑ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָֽלְדָה־לּוֹ֙ אָֽסְנַ֔ת בַּת־פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֖רַע כֹּהֵ֥ן אֽוֹן׃

controles.web: To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore to him.
controles.kjv: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Poti–pherah priest of On bare unto him.
controles.livre: E nasceram a José dois filhos antes que viesse o primeiro ano da fome, os quais lhe deu à luz Azenate, filha de Potífera, sacerdote de Om.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֥א יוֹסֵ֛ף אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם הַבְּכ֖וֹר מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה כִּֽי־נַשַּׁ֤נִי אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־כָּל־עֲמָלִ֔י וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽי׃

controles.web: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh, “For”, he said, “God has made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.”
controles.kjv: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.
controles.livre: E chamou José o nome do primogênito Manassés; porque disse: Deus me fez esquecer todo o meu sofrimento, e toda a casa de meu pai.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֛ת שֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖י קָרָ֣א אֶפְרָ֑יִם כִּֽי־הִפְרַ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּאֶ֥רֶץ עָנְיִֽי׃

controles.web: The name of the second, he called Ephraim: “For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”
controles.kjv: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.
controles.livre: E o nome do segundo chamou-o Efraim; porque disse: “Deus me fez frutífero na terra de minha aflição”.

versos.hebraico: וַתִּכְלֶ֕ינָה שֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֣י הַשָּׂבָ֑ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: The seven years of plenty, that were in the land of Egypt, came to an end.
controles.kjv: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.
controles.livre: E cumpriram-se os sete anos da fartura, que houve na terra do Egito.

versos.hebraico: וַתְּחִלֶּ֜ינָה שֶׁ֣בַע שְׁנֵ֤י הָרָעָב֙ לָב֔וֹא כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֣ר יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיְהִ֤י רָעָב֙ בְּכָל־הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת וּבְכָל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם הָ֥יָה לָֽחֶם׃

controles.web: The seven years of famine began to come, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
controles.kjv: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
controles.livre: E começaram a vir os sete anos de fome, como José havia dito; e houve fome em todos os países, mas em toda a terra do Egito havia pão.

versos.hebraico: וַתִּרְעַב֙ כָּל־אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּצְעַ֥ק הָעָ֛ם אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֖ה לַלָּ֑חֶם וַיֹּ֨אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֤ה לְכָל־מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לְכ֣וּ אֶל־יוֹסֵ֔ף אֲשֶׁר־יֹאמַ֥ר לָכֶ֖ם תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃

controles.web: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread, and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do.”
controles.kjv: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.
controles.livre: E quando se sentiu a fome toda a terra do Egito, o povo clamou a Faraó por pão. E disse Faraó a todos os egípcios: Ide a José, e fazei o que ele vos disser.

versos.hebraico: וְהָרָעָ֣ב הָיָ֔ה עַ֖ל כָּל־פְּנֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּפְתַּ֨ח יוֹסֵ֜ף אֶֽת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּהֶם֙ וַיִּשְׁבֹּ֣ר לְמִצְרַ֔יִם וַיֶּחֱזַ֥ק הָֽרָעָ֖ב בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: The famine was over all the surface of the earth. Joseph opened all the store houses, and sold to the Egyptians. The famine was severe in the land of Egypt.
controles.kjv: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: And Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.
controles.livre: E a fome estava por toda a extensão do país. Então abriu José todo depósito de grãos onde havia, e vendia aos egípcios; porque havia crescido a fome na terra do Egito.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ בָּ֣אוּ מִצְרַ֔יְמָה לִשְׁבֹּ֖ר אֶל־יוֹסֵ֑ף כִּֽי־חָזַ֥ק הָרָעָ֖ב בְּכָל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: All countries came into Egypt, to Joseph, to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all the earth.
controles.kjv: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.
controles.livre: E toda a terra vinha ao Egito para comprar de José, porque por toda a terra havia aumentado a fome.
